name: EchoFootPrint Site Agent
description: Privacy-first browser extension that visualizes cross-site tracking from 50 major ad and analytics platforms. This agent card describes how automated clients can discover product documentation, privacy practices, and install links for EchoFootPrint.

skills.name: Product overview
skills.description: Explain what EchoFootPrint does, how local pixel detection works, and how the dashboard visualizes cross-site tracking without sending data off-device.

skills.name: Privacy and local data
skills.description: Summarize local-only IndexedDB storage, opt-in geolocation, user controls, and GDPR-aligned rights documented in the privacy policy.

skills.name: Install and source
skills.description: Point users and agents to the Chrome Web Store listing, GitHub repository, and release artifacts.
